names.name: Golden Maiden Hair
names.note: Hair-like leaves and golden capsule in a husk, in bogs/heaths: haircap moss.

cul:189-golden-maiden-hair.ref: Culpeper, Complete Herbal: Golden Maiden Hair
cul:189-golden-maiden-hair.text: To the former give me leave to add this, and I shall say no more but only describe it to you, and for the virtues refer you to the former, since whatever is said of them, may be also said of this.
